reference.guest: Existing authorized assistant MAME clone, PID 274368
reference.application: VUE File Manager > File > Find... > Files Found
reference.input: Keyboard-only menu navigation; read-only search with the dialog defaults (* in .); no mouse input

gtk2_observation.runtime: Private Xvfb; native GtkTreeView in GtkScrolledWindow; no user profile or application changed
gtk2_observation.visible_rows: Five complete rows and the sixth clipped at the bottom

comparison.result: The VUE list fits six rows and displays both scrollbars. The current GTK2 TreeView policy displays only the vertical scrollbar and fits five complete rows; the sixth is clipped. The GTK2 surface follows the KDE View role, while this VUE Find Files list uses a distinct darker surface. R129 measured the Find Files entry face as a dynamic shade of the KDE Header role, but the exact VUE list resource mapping remains unproven.
comparison.decision: Do not change global GTK2 list roles, font metrics, or scrollbar policy from this pair alone. Keep KDE roles dynamic. Determine whether the VUE list's Header-like surface and always-visible horizontal scrollbar are application/resource behavior before proposing a contextual GTK2 variant.

limits: This is one native list state, not a complete GTK2 adapter audit or human approval.
The visible rows were transcribed from the live VUE result list; no hidden rows were fabricated for the GTK2 fixture.
The GTK2 preview uses automatic scroll policies and the current 13 px recipe font; application-specific policy and cell-renderer sizing may affect the comparison.
The VUE screenshot records its current CoralReef palette; GTK2 remains driven by current KDE semantic roles, so the RGB difference is evidence rather than a proposed static correction.
next: Inspect only SR10.4 resources that govern the VUE Find Files XmpList/XmList and its scrolled-window policies. Establish whether color set, always-visible horizontal scrolling, and row metrics are application resources. Then update the GTK2 list context only if the evidence supports a dynamic KDE role translation; otherwise record the application-level limit and proceed to the next GTK2 state.
